mentions.name: Branching story writing website
mentions.description: A website for collaborative branching storytelling, letting users write a story one block at a time and branch the narrative off wherever they want to take it. Revived after being abandoned a few years ago.
mentions.source_excerpt: A friend of mine recently expressed interest in writing a story with me, which gave me the drive I needed to pick back up a project I abandoned a few years back. It's a website for writing a story one block at a time, branching off wherever you feel like you'd want to move the story.
